newTaCZ.label: Doom Pack
newTaCZ.summary: A focused Doom-inspired TaCZ pack featuring the BFG-9000 and another heavy weapon. A useful contrast to realistic rifle collections.
newTaCZ.idea: Study the oversized BFG silhouette, visible energy charging and dramatic projectile feedback for original AoA blasters.
newTaCZ.access: Free public pack; optional creator support
newTaCZ.caution: Creator names TaCZ 1.1.4 or newer. Retained as a distinctive older release, not described as newly updated.

newTaCZ.label: FortCraft
newTaCZ.summary: Fortnite-inspired firearms including the Mammoth Pistol, its explosive variant and the Heavy Impact Sniper Rifle.
newTaCZ.idea: Study exaggerated scale and strong weapon-specific silhouettes without importing a whole realistic military aesthetic.
newTaCZ.access: Free public pack; optional creator support
newTaCZ.caution: Use the exact creator-listed TaCZ requirements and matching pack file; no cross-version compatibility is inferred.

newTaCZ.label: It a Big Gun!!!
newTaCZ.summary: A deliberately oversized TaCZ collection that turns artillery-inspired shapes into portable game weapons.
newTaCZ.idea: Study comically oversized barrels, heavy handling and playful scale for AoA launchers and cannons.
newTaCZ.caution: The creator describes TaCZ 1.1.4+ support. An older reference retained for its unusual concept, not a promise of current-instance compatibility.

newTaCZ.label: Infinite Origin Weapon Pack
newTaCZ.summary: A small TaCZ pack combining less-common firearms with an artist-authorized concept-weapon collaboration.
newTaCZ.idea: Study how an illustrated weapon concept becomes a readable, animated Minecraft firearm.
newTaCZ.access: Free public release; region-limited paid beta described by creator
newTaCZ.caution: The creator states that official releases are free. Paid beta testing is restricted to China; no international beta access is promised.

creatorEnrichment.label: Gamma Gunpack
creatorEnrichment.access: Free public release; optional Patreon support
creatorEnrichment.note: The creator describes CurseForge as the complete public playable release. Patreon supports development previews, behind-the-scenes posts and polls, not a required purchase for the public gunpack.

creatorEnrichment.label: Fibers' Guns Pack
creatorEnrichment.access: Free public pack; creator Patreon previews
creatorEnrichment.note: The creator has publicly shown the Ray Gun on Patreon. That post is a dated preview, not evidence that the current public gunpack requires payment.

creatorEnrichment.label: Argos Weaponry
creatorEnrichment.access: Free public builds; Patreon early access and premium extras
creatorEnrichment.note: This is a Point Blank add-on, not a TaCZ pack. The creator links Patreon for early access and separate premium content. Existing provider records are enriched, not counted as new gunpacks.

knownLinks.label: Creator Patreon: early access and premium extras

creatorEnrichment.label: Jonhnathan's Pack
creatorEnrichment.access: Free public gunpack; optional creator support
creatorEnrichment.note: An existing gunpack, not a new discovery. Creator support destinations are surfaced alongside its original public download.

paidReference.name: AEG-Tactical
paidReference.author: Fission_Track Studio
paidReference.summary: A creator-hosted Bedrock firearm add-on with tactical models and aiming/reload animation. It is a separate paid reference, not a Java TaCZ gunpack.
paidReference.idea: Study detailed first-person gun presentation in a separate Bedrock implementation; do not infer Java compatibility.
cautions: Paid access on the creator post. No private attachment or mod binary was downloaded.
The public description lists Bedrock 1.21.90+; select the purchased build matching your game. Native compatibility has not been tested.
The creator says the boots armor slot is used. Check the equipment limitation before buying.
The Barrett shown in one promotional image is explicitly future content. It is not counted as released.
paidReference.publicEvidence: Public creator post read on 2026-10-23, including access terms and version/equipment limitations; full private content not accessed.

scope: Four newly identified TaCZ gunpacks and one separately labeled paid Bedrock reference, plus creator-link enrichment of existing entries. No private files or paywall bypass. Source claims are not native runtime testing.
